newsitem.title: FRANCE: Promodes stock rises on 1996 sales.
newsitem.headline: Promodes stock rises on 1996 sales.

text.p: Shares in French hypermarkets group Promodes rose sharply on Monday on the back of the company's 1996 sales, which were up 2.9 percent, or seven percent on a like-for-like basis.
Promodes shares were up 4.8 percent at 1,637 francs at 1235 GMT, while the bourse's CAC-40 index was 0.42 percent higher.

"The turnover was slightly better than forecast and reflects an improvement in French hypermarkets activity in the second half," said a portfolio manager, who added that Promodes shares had lagged recently. Promodes said fourth-quarter sales rose 6.8 percent when it released its results last Friday afternoon.
Another fund manager said investors were "reassured by the seven percent rise in turnover" on a like-for-like basis.
Traders were not aware of any changes in recommendations on the share.
